# fix: missing closing brace in openAggregateJavadoc task in javadoc.gradle

## Bug
`gradle/javadoc.gradle` had a missing closing `}` on the `openAggregateJavadoc`
task registration block, so `openJavadoc` was parsed as a nested closure inside
it. Gradle failed at end of file:

> expecting '}', found '' @ line 342, column 1.

## Root Cause
An unbalanced brace in the task registration block. `openJavadoc` was defined
immediately after, so the parser consumed it as part of the unclosed closure and
only reported the failure at end of file, far from the real line.

## Severity vs. Priority
**Severity (technical impact):** Blocker — the build script would not parse, so
no Gradle task could run.
**Priority (business urgency):** P1

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `gradle/javadoc.gradle` parses (`./gradlew tasks --group documentation`)
- [x] `openAggregateJavadoc` and `openJavadoc` are sibling tasks, not nested
      (`grep -c "tasks.register('openJavadoc')" gradle/javadoc.gradle` returns 1
      at top level)

## Notes
Fixed in `201041b`. Bugs sit outside the Epic to Story to Task hierarchy, so
this has no parent section; the earlier body named epic #76 in prose.
